clips.title: The story
paras: Shadow Magic is a desperate task given by Marshal Marris to disrupt the dark arts bolstering the Blackrock invasion of Redridge. Blackrock shadowcasters have brought demon-tainted midnight orbs to the battlefield, weaponizing dark energies against the beleaguered defenders of Lakeshire. Securing and destroying these cursed relics is vital to holding the town's defensive line.

While brute force has always been the hallmark of the Blackrock clan, their recent incursions into the Redridge Mountains display a far more insidious threat. The invaders have bolstered their ranks with shadowcasters wielding dark powers. These casters do not rely on sorcery alone; they channel their fel and shadow energies through demon-tainted artifacts known as midnight orbs. The artifacts have inflicted terrible losses upon the local town militia, tilting an already desperate war further in favor of the invaders.

Marshal Marris, coordinating Lakeshire's strained defense from the town center, understands that ordinary steel cannot easily overcome dark relics. Allowing the Blackrock orcs to retain their midnight orbs risks the complete collapse of Redridge's eastern borders. By ordering adventurers to slay the shadowcasters and seize the orbs, Marris seeks not to repurpose this dangerous magic, but to have the demonic relics destroyed.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Blackrock orcs enlisted shadowcasters to aid their attacks in Redridge, and they have brought with them devices of dark power--midnight orbs. These orbs have struck telling blows against Redridge's defenders, and it's imperative we remove the demon-tainted items from the conflict.
Find and deliver to me midnight orbs from slain Blackrock shadowcasters. I will then have them disposed of, for this world would be a better place without them!

clips.title: Progress
paras: How goes your conflict with the shadowcasters? Did you find the midnight orbs?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. I'll send these to be destroyed immediately.
